message: Astra: In this notebook scene, your latest attempt again moves from the tree’s winter-white lower half to lessons about change; can you picture the tree itself clearly enough to distinguish observation from interpretation? What detail needs your attention most, and what would let you judge whether a reader can see it? Would thinking longer resolve that uncertainty better than trying a revision now, or is there something about the image you need to decide before drafting? Could you choose and carry out the next step on that basis?
